facts.text: Columbia Southern offers a self-paced LifePace Learning format featuring 11 start dates each year, nine-week terms, and no required login times.

sources.title: Online Learning Experience - Columbia Southern University
sources.quote: LifePace Learning® was designed to fit the needs and lifestyles of working adults by combining the flexibility you need with a time-based structure that provides the best opportunity for a consistent path towards graduation.
